prompts.prompt: With default Windows DNS Server aging and scavenging settings, how many total days pass before a stale dynamically-registered record becomes eligible for scavenging? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/windows-dns/SKILL.md - Aging and Scavenging: total record lifetime = no-refresh (7 days) + refresh (7 days) = 14 days
